title_template: {work_unit_id} — Reusable canonical Work Unit materialization authority preparation
goal: Prepare a default-deny reusable authority boundary that may create exactly one deterministic canonical PNCC Work Unit intake Issue from an exact PLAN_ONLY materialization proposal.
scope: prepare an exact reusable Issue-intake materialization authority contract bound to the canonical planner and policy
define fresh Provider Truth, NO_WORK, deterministic proposal, duplicate-prevention and exact-current-main preconditions
define one-Issue-only target constraints and fail-closed provider readback requirements
keep the preparation transaction default-deny until separate explicit Owner Authorization
forbidden_scope: grant reusable Issue-write authority in the preparation transaction
create more than one canonical Work Unit Issue
mutate an existing Issue, PR or unrelated branch
mutate provider-state or Writer Lease under the materialization authority
perform runtime or product/runtime source mutation
mutate ADWF binding, release/tag/promotion, rulesets, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 lifecycle
exit_criteria: future authority target is exactly one planner-derived canonical intake Issue
all planner/policy/provider/main/proposal anchors are explicit and fail closed
no Issue creation is performed by the preparation Work Unit
